releaseNotes: Forgot Password Flow — password reset capability using Firebase Auth.
ForgotPasswordScreen — custom vertical gradient theme with inline animated success indicator.
Input focus chaining — fluid keyboard navigation (Next / Done actions) across all text fields.
Google Sign-In branding — compliant layout and asset conforming to Google's official design specs.
WCAG AA-compliant colors — enhanced field contrast ratios (> 4.5:1) over dark gradients.
Refactored authentication screens — unified vertical gradient backgrounds and new brand dumbbell assets.
Loading state lockouts — disabled inputs and actions during active Firebase requests to prevent race conditions.
